results.description:
SIENNA

I woke up on my twenty-sixth birthday in a Vegas honeymoon suite with a ring of athletic tape on my finger.

The man asleep on the other side of the bed is Ronan Wolfe. The most hated enforcer in hockey. The player I was hired to keep in one piece. My husband.

And the video of me proposing to him on one knee has three million views.

One night. One very bad decision. And now my whole career depends on staying married to him.

So we sign. A contract, a deadline, and rules. Separate rooms. No touching. No feelings. Smile for the cameras until the last game of the season, then walk away like it never happened.

He's rude. He's huge. He grunts instead of talking.

He's also the only man who's ever looked at me like I'm the thing worth protecting.

RONAN

I don't do relationships. I do penalty minutes.

Everybody in this league thinks they know what I am. A pair of fists on skates. The man you send out when you want somebody to bleed. They're not wrong.

Then I wake up married to the team's new trainer, with her red hair and her smart mouth, and the whole internet wants to know what she sees in me.

I signed her contract. I'll keep her rules.

I'll keep my hands off her if it kills me.

It might. Because every night she patches me up, and every morning I want her more, and the day this season ends I'm supposed to let her go.

This is the first book in The Big Bad Wolfe Series. Reading order:

Reckless Ice.

Dirty Ice.

Fearless Ice.
